claims.title: SCA3 is associated with an ATXN3 CAG repeat expansion
claims.plain_language: SCA3 is an inherited neurological condition associated with an expanded CAG repeat in one copy of the ATXN3 gene.
claims.boundary: A genetic result must be interpreted by a qualified clinician or genetic counsellor; repeat size alone cannot precisely predict an individual's course.

claims.title: A Mainland China cohort estimated annual SARA progression
claims.plain_language: In a two-year longitudinal cohort, the estimated average annual SARA increase was 1.49 points, with substantial limits on applying a cohort average to one person.
claims.boundary: This is a cohort estimate, not a personal prediction.
claims.source_title: The Natural History of SCA3 in Mainland China

claims.title: EUROSCA found measurable long-term change in SARA
claims.plain_language: The long-term EUROSCA analysis estimated an average SARA increase of 1.56 points per year for its SCA3 cohort.
claims.boundary: Cohort composition, baseline severity and follow-up can affect estimates.
claims.source_title: Long-term disease progression in SCA1, SCA2, SCA3, and SCA6

claims.title: ESMI follows clinical, fluid and MRI markers across disease stages
claims.plain_language: The ESMI cohort reported stage-dependent changes in SARA, neurofilament light and MRI measures, illustrating that candidate outcomes behave differently across the disease course.
claims.boundary: This linked snapshot is a medRxiv preprint, not the journal version. A biomarker association does not by itself establish clinical benefit or suitability for an individual.
claims.source_title: Progression of biological markers in SCA3 (medRxiv preprint)

claims.title: Public human spinal-cord transcriptomics are available
claims.plain_language: GSE309548 contains public SCA3 and control human spinal-cord RNA-seq files that can support donor-aware molecular research.
claims.boundary: Post-mortem expression associations are not diagnostic or prognostic tests.
